scientific_scope.cord_test_use: One evaluation after development-only model and threshold selection; never training, model selection, calibration fitting, or threshold tuning.

line_item_evaluation.E0: Historical v3.1 path/occurrence comparison with ordered repeated leaves and row identity discarded.
line_item_evaluation.E1: Strict diagnostic comparison of ground-truth and predicted menu rows by list position.
line_item_evaluation.E2: Primary permutation-invariant maximum-weight bipartite matching; row identifiers need not agree.
line_item_evaluation.tie_breaker: Stable lexicographic predicted/ground-truth indices only; financial arithmetic never changes primary matching.
line_item_evaluation.row_exact_definition: A matched row has identical normalized field multisets, with no missing or spurious leaf.
line_item_evaluation.row_alignment_error_definition: E2 finds a positive-weight match different from E1 position, or E1 has a lower matched-field weight than E2.

targets.document_has_critical_error: Any non-exact supported document total, subtotal, tax, discount, matched/unmatched item total price, or item unit price.
targets.document_has_line_item_critical_error: Any missing, spurious, or incorrect critical monetary field within E2 matched/unmatched menu rows.
targets.document_has_row_alignment_error: The frozen E2 row_alignment_error_definition is true for at least one document row.
targets.weighted_critical_loss: Sum of erroneous supported field weights divided by the sum of supported ground-truth plus spurious-prediction weights; bounded to [0,1].

feature_policy.disagreement_rule: Include only when task-compatible predictions for the same inference document genuinely exist. Total-only disagreement must never be named row/line-item disagreement.
feature_policy.missing_feature_policy: Unavailable candidate families are omitted, not imputed from ground truth. Numeric production features may use a development-fitted median plus an explicit missing indicator when naturally missing at inference.

development_data.source: Authorized CORD validation clean predictions plus v3.1 controlled-corruption validation predictions; no CORD test rows.
development_data.variant_group_integrity: All clean/corrupted versions of a source document remain in one split and one grouped-CV fold.

fixed_partition.method: Sort SHA-256(seed + source_document_id); first 60% FIT, next 20% THRESHOLD_SELECTION, final 20% INDEPENDENT_CERTIFICATION.

development_data.error_diversity_policy: Prefer source-document diversity; corrupted variants are never counted as independent statistical units. Expand validation-only frozen inference only if candidate fitting cannot proceed because a target class is absent.

R5.name: rank_average_R3_R4
R5.eligibility: Only if both components are valid; no additional learned weight.

model_selection.cross_validation: Five-fold GroupKFold by source_document_id within FIT; reduce folds only if fewer than five positive-containing source groups, and report.
model_selection.interpretability_preference: Prefer an interpretable model when its relative AURC is within 5% of the best candidate.
model_selection.bootstrap: Document-group bootstrap with 2000 replicates; all variants from a sampled group move together.

certification.weighted_loss_bound: One-sided empirical Bernstein bound for losses in [0,1], with the exact formula recorded in code and evidence.
certification.threshold_selection: For each target, select the maximum-coverage eligible threshold using FIT and THRESHOLD_SELECTION only, then freeze before opening INDEPENDENT_CERTIFICATION outcomes.
certification.assumptions: Experimental research certificate conditional on source-document exchangeability and unchanged pipeline; not regulatory or universally distribution-free.

promotion_gates.operating_gate: At review_rate <= 0.50, critical-error capture >= 0.85 OR critical false-accept <= 0.10 with automation coverage >= 0.50.
promotion_gates.deterministic_regression_gates: V1/V2/V3/v3.1 tests, evidence, schema, fault, security and runtime verification remain passing.
